description: SkipHow continuity: at startup, point the session at the skill; after compaction or resume, require reconstruction from the owner request, repository instructions, host tasks, Git and GitHub, and the handoff.

hooks.command: sh -c 'printf "%s\n" "SkipHow is installed. For any request about this project (a bug, a fix, a feature, ideas to save, research, review, or tracked work), invoke the skiphow skill before acting. If .skiphow/handoff.md exists, unfinished work is described there and its latest checkpoint follows."; if [ -f .skiphow/handoff.md ]; then tail -n 40 .skiphow/handoff.md; fi; exit 0'

sh -c 'printf "%s\n" "SkipHow: this session was compacted or resumed. Re-read the owner request, repository instructions, observable active host tasks, live Git and GitHub; verify checkout, branch, HEAD, and candidate before acting. If .skiphow/handoff.md exists, its latest checkpoint follows; delete it once every selected item is done."; if [ -f .skiphow/handoff.md ]; then tail -n 40 .skiphow/handoff.md; fi; exit 0'
